jacketed.basis: Reference value: widely reported QuickLOAD default for jacketed lead-core bullets (research/raw/physics.md [50][150][151]); within the 24-44 MPa first engraving peak reported for 6.5-9.3 mm jacketed bullets [47].

monolithic.basis: Fitted to 60 published pressure-tested loads with monolithic bullets (33 powders), relative to the 25 MPa jacketed reference, by scripts/calibrate-powders.ts.

lead.basis: Third-party default (OpenReloading [48]); replaced by a value fitted to published pressure-tested loads when scripts/calibrate-powders.ts has run.
